The '''Great Shell Dome''' was the holding place of the [[sun caves]] where the [[Golden Sun]] was held. The dome itself was made of a huge number of interlocking [[seashell]]s coated with a special varnish that allowed the structure to withstand all but the most powerful [[Starship/Legends|starship]] weapons. Measuring thirty [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length and rising fifteen meters in height, the Dome was visible from a distance.<ref name="BGS" />
